skill.title: Projection
skill.promise: You can see one arrow's shadow on another.

lessons.title: Shadow on a line

screens.prompt: The shadow of an arrow on a rightward line keeps...

feedback.wrong_option: The line points right, so the shadow keeps the rightward part.

screens.correctMessage: The shadow keeps the part along the line.

screens.prompt: The shadow runs 4 right from (1, 3).

feedback.wrong_direction: The shadow lies on the horizontal line.
feedback.wrong_length: The aim is right. The run is 4.

screens.correctMessage: The shadow stays on the line.

screens.prompt: Arrow (4, 3) onto a horizontal line. The shadow length is...

feedback.wrong_option: 3 is the part off the line. 7 adds both parts.

screens.correctMessage: The shadow length is the matching part.

screens.prompt: The leftover upward part is...

feedback.wrong_option: The shadow keeps only the part along the line.

screens.correctMessage: The rest drops away.

screens.prompt: A shadow runs from x = 2 to x = 8. Set its length.

feedback.too_low: The ends are farther apart. Move higher.
feedback.too_high: The gap is smaller than that. Move lower.

screens.correctMessage: Only the matching part stays.

lessons.whyItMatters: A projection keeps the part of a signal along one direction.

lessons.title: Onto the vertical

screens.prompt: Onto the y axis, (2, 5) leaves a shadow of...

feedback.wrong_option: (2, 0) is the shadow on the x axis. The y axis keeps (0, 5).

screens.correctMessage: Vertical shadow, horizontal part gone.

screens.prompt: The vertical part runs from y = 1 to y = 7. Set the shadow length.

feedback.too_low: The vertical part is taller. Move higher.
feedback.too_high: The horizontal part is not on this axis. Move lower.

screens.correctMessage: The shadow is the vertical part.

screens.prompt: Draw that vertical shadow, length 4, from (4, 1).

feedback.wrong_length: The aim is up. The length is 4.

screens.correctMessage: The shadow stands on the vertical line.

screens.prompt: A perpendicular arrow casts...

feedback.wrong_option: Perpendicular means no shared direction, so the shadow length is 0.

screens.correctMessage: Nothing lands on the line.

screens.prompt: (0, 4) onto the x axis has shadow length...

feedback.wrong_option: The arrow is vertical. The horizontal shadow has nothing to keep.

screens.correctMessage: No horizontal part, no shadow.

lessons.whyItMatters: The shadow on the y axis keeps the vertical part.

lessons.title: Project twice

screens.prompt: (3, 0) onto the x axis is...

feedback.wrong_option: It already lies on the x axis. The shadow is itself.

screens.correctMessage: Already on the line, so it stays.

screens.prompt: Projecting twice onto the same line...

feedback.wrong_option: The second projection sees an arrow that is already on the line.

screens.correctMessage: The second pass is the same shadow.

screens.prompt: The shadow runs from x = 2 to x = 6. After a second projection, set the length.

feedback.too_low: The second pass keeps the same gap. Move higher.
feedback.too_high: The second pass does not grow the shadow. Move lower.

screens.correctMessage: The shadow length stays the gap.

screens.prompt: Draw (3, 0) from (2, 2).

feedback.wrong_length: The aim is right. The length is 3.

screens.correctMessage: The shadow is the horizontal arrow.

screens.prompt: Keeping only the part along one direction is a...

options.label: A turn onto a new heading

feedback.wrong_option: A turn would change the aim. A projection keeps the matching aim.

screens.correctMessage: That kept part is a projection.

lessons.whyItMatters: Projecting twice onto the same line changes nothing the second time.

lessons.title: Name the shadow

screens.prompt: Arrow (4, 2) onto (1, 0). The shadow is...

feedback.wrong_option: (0, 2) keeps the off-line part. (4, 2) keeps both.

screens.correctMessage: The horizontal part stays.

screens.prompt: The second number of that shadow is...

feedback.wrong_option: 2 was the part off the line. The shadow drops it.

screens.correctMessage: The off-line part is 0 on the shadow.

screens.prompt: A horizontal shadow from x = 1 to x = 6. Set its length.

feedback.too_low: The matching part is longer. Move higher.
feedback.too_high: The matching part is shorter. Move lower.

screens.correctMessage: The first number is the run along the line.

screens.prompt: The off-line part of (4, 2) on the x axis...

feedback.wrong_option: The shadow is the matching part. The rest is discarded.

screens.correctMessage: Only the agreement along the line stays.

screens.prompt: (1, 4) onto (0, 1). The shadow is...

feedback.wrong_option: (1, 0) is the shadow on the x axis. (1, 4) drops nothing.

screens.correctMessage: The vertical part stays.

lessons.whyItMatters: You used the agreement with (1, 0) to keep the matching part.
